The subjects are arranged in a diagonal line leading from the background to the foreground, with the foremost character taking up the right side of the frame, creating a clear visual hierarchy.

Ensure the illustration is suitable for use as training data in a comic book art style recognition model or as a prompt for a character illustration generation system.
